sasha: Ran a 16k soak on the new v2-smallquant build and hit a deterministic divergence around ~8.2k tokens. KV cache hit-rate tanks and outputs go funky :confused:
ian: Can you paste the exact bench command and a short log snippet?
sasha: Repro command:
```
./bench --model v2-smallquant --ctx 16384 --input tests/longflight.txt --mode streaming --batch 1
```
Log excerpt (simplified):
```
[0008s] tokens=8200 KV-hit=96.8%
[0009s] tokens=8201 KV-hit=61.7%  <-- sudden drop
[0010s] sample[8202]: "the quick brown fox"  <-- misaligned continuation vs reference
```
maya: Interesting — were you using blockwise int4? RoPE scaling + int4 rounding can cause phase drift at long offsets. Which quant profile?
sasha: quant-bot reported: `quant_profile=int4_blockwise, clip=0.985, per-channel=false`
ian: Try reproducing with prefix cache disabled to see if it's cache corruption vs rotary mis-indexing: `--no-prefix-cache` and also run `--rotate-check` (small helper that verifies ropemap monotonicity).
sasha: Did that. With `--no-prefix-cache` the generation stays correct beyond 12k tokens. With cache enabled, fails reliably at ~8200.
ian: That points to cache indexing / window wrap logic. Any off-by-one in the shard index math?
sasha: Found a suspicious piece in cache ring code, pre-PR patch: `if (idx > window) idx -= window;` I changed to `if (idx >= window) idx -= window;` — quick local test looks promising (no repro after 50k tokens).
maya: Nice catch. Could still be quantization + alignment exacerbating it. Can you run a comparison across variants? smallquant vs smallfp16 vs smallint8? Keep same prompt.
sasha: Running overnight matrix: smallfp16 (baseline), smallint8, smallquant (current). Early results: smallfp16 no repro; smallint8 intermittent (less severe); smallquant deterministic.
ian: Create a regression test that streams > 12k tokens with a known golden-check after each 1024 tokens and fail on any mismatch. Attach to the PR.
sasha: Will add the test. PR draft: https://redwood.internal/pulls/1234 — includes the >= change, unit test for ring wrap, and the new soak test harness entry.
quant-bot: Auto-report: quant-suite run triggered for PR 1234; adding int4/blockwise re-eval to CI.
devops-bot: FYI running full GPU soak on dedicated-nodes-3, ETA 6h.
alerts-bot: Note: customer-prod cluster had a minor spike matching this pattern last week (ticket #AI-487). Linking as possible root cause.
ian: After CI + soak, if green we should backport to release branch and schedule dedicated capacity warm restart.
sasha: Thanks team — I'll push the test and ping when CI completes. :thumbsup:
